method.data: ZTF forced-aperture light curves from IRSA (catflags mask 32768, error <= 0.20 mag), all filters pooled as relative flux
method.test: box least squares scan within +-0.2 percent of the TESS period, durations [0.7, 1.0] x the TESS duration
method.null: 300 control periods per star, away from harmonics of the TESS period; p = share of controls with signal-to-noise at least the observed
method.power: 24 injected eclipses of the TESS depth per star; power = share recovered above the 99-percentile of the controls
method.confirmed: p <= 0.01, at least 2 eclipse epochs with points, and depth ratio to TESS inside [0.3, 3.0] allowing 2 sigma
method.not_seen: power >= 0.5 and not confirmed: ZTF could have seen it and did not
method.inconclusive: power < 0.5 and not confirmed: ZTF could not have told
method.no_data: fewer than 40 clean points or under 30 days of baseline (ZTF does not cover most of the far south)
method.not_independent_of: the TESS period and duration, which are the test's starting point
